title: The Granary Thief
summary: [Reputation: Good] You showed Orsk mercy, and Ashford is watching to see if you meant it. Someone has been stealing from the granary you filled before winter: Corwin, an Ashford refugee. Let him go and cover the loss yourself (you become a Saint), or punish him (you slip to Wavering).

goals.say: The village will tell this story for years.

threats.name: Corwin the Refugee
talk: For my sister's children. Ashford has nothing left.
The village needs it for winter.
I know. I'd do it again. I'm sorry.
What would you have me do?
Whatever you think is right. You're the only one here they listen to.

spare.label: Let him go, and pay for the grain yourself
spare.line: Corwin cries. The village elder looks at you differently now.
